description: 01:45 - 03:30: Continued discussing way forward. Discussed risks, barrier status, well control contingencies. Agreed to attempt to pull tubing hanger with 152bar trapped pressure below DHSV. Updated change log. Meanwhile applied 20 bar to tubing and inflow tested DHSV, good. Continued with rig maintenance and pressure tested valves s1 and c26, good
